claim_citation.quote: In despair, he creates a construct of his dead little sister, Ellie, to calm his mother.

candidates.summary: The most insane construct in the set: John creates a realistic dead-sister construct to comfort his dementia-stricken mother. This is a temporary, emotionally targeted construct that later becomes an ongoing autonomous presence in the run.
candidates.title: Dead-sister construct Ellie
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John manifests Ellie as a lifelike construct and presents her to his mother as a comforting companion.

claim_citation.quote: John Stewart decided to build a sniper rifle construct that was so precise and deadly that it only took one shot to thwart the threat from such a long distance.

candidates.summary: Assisted/weapon construct. John forms a sniper rifle with enough precision to make a single, long-range disabling shot.
candidates.title: Green Lantern Corps
candidates.what_visibly_happens: He manifests a rifle, sights the target at extreme range, and fires one precise shot.

candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart’s construct bubble that trapped Martian Manhunter

claim_citation.quote: John Stewart creates another with his ring and heads off to stop the aspect, but he encases the Manhunter with his power ring to prevent him from following.

candidates.summary: A partial construct, used as a temporary restraint. John tries to solve the Xanshi crisis alone and locks Martian Manhunter out of the fight, which contributes to the disaster.
candidates.title: Cosmic Odyssey
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John surrounds Martian Manhunter in a glowing green bubble-construct so he cannot follow him, then heads toward the bomb alone.

claim_citation.quote: John then uses his power to create a group of Marines, who fight alongside him against the Black Lanterns.

candidates.summary: A full-assisted combat construct. John manifests an entire squad of Marines to back him up against the Black Lanterns while dealing with Katma Tui’s return.
candidates.title: Green Lantern
candidates.what_visibly_happens: A lineup of green Marine constructs appears and fights beside John in the middle of the Black Lantern battle.

candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart’s sniper rifle construct used to kill Mogo

claim_citation.quote: John then constructs a sniper rifle and prepares to fire a bullet into Mogo's core.

candidates.summary: A temporary tactical construct with huge consequences. John uses the ring to build a sniper rifle and shoots into Mogo’s core to stop the corrupted rings.
candidates.title: Green Lantern Corps
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John forms a precision rifle construct, takes aim, and fires the shot that kills the living planet Mogo.
